key: The Jasper Ward was completely locked down all of a sudden.
en: The Jasper Ward was completely locked down all of a sudden.
ja: ジャスパーワードが、突然完全に封鎖されちゃったの。

key: I have a friend who lives up there, and I haven't heard a word from her since.
en: I have a friend who lives up there, and I haven't heard a word from her since.
ja: あそこに住んでる友達がいるんだけど、それ以来一言も連絡がないんだ。

key: I hope she's all right.
en: I hope she's all right.
ja: 無事だといいけど。

key: Sure is nice that the city's coming together.
en: Sure is nice that the city's coming together.
ja: 街がまとまりつつあるのは、いいことだね。

key: But I never leave here anyway, so also whatever.
en: But I never leave here anyway, so also whatever.
ja: まあ、わたしはどうせここから出ないから、どうでもいいけど。

key: Hey, my friend said you went and got her in Jasper. Thanks a ton.
en: Hey, my friend said you went and got her in Jasper.  Thanks a ton.
ja: ねえ、友達から、あなたがジャスパーまで迎えに行ってくれたって聞いたよ。本当にありがとう。

key: I'm so relieved to know that she's okay... I wanted to give you something for your help.
en: I'm so relieved to know that she's okay... I wanted to give you something for your help.
ja: 無事だって分かって、すごくほっとした……お礼に何か渡したかったんだ。

key: \PN obtained a Department Store Sticker: Tangela!
en: \PN obtained a Department Store Sticker: Tangela!
ja: \PNはデパートシール「モンジャラ」を手に入れた!

key: Hm. You don't have a Department Store Card?
en: Hm. You don't have a Department Store Card?
ja: ん? デパートカード持ってないの?

key: Well, go grab one. They're free. Then I have an addition for it.
en: Well, go grab one. They're free. Then I have an addition for it.
ja: それなら取ってきなよ。無料だから。それがあれば、これを追加できるんだ。

key: It's really cool you go out of your way to help random strangers. This city could use more people like you.
en: It's really cool you go out of your way to help random strangers. This city could use more people like you.
ja: 見ず知らずの人のためにわざわざ助けてあげるなんて、本当にかっこいいよ。この街には、あなたみたいな人がもっと必要だね。

key: Oh, you're the one who found me!
en: Oh, you're the one who found me!
ja: あ、わたしを見つけてくれた人だ!

key: I can't thank you enough, I probably would have stayed up there forever.
en: I can't thank you enough, I probably would have stayed up there forever.
ja: 感謝してもしきれないよ、あのままだったらずっとあそこにいるところだった。

key: I'm kind of air-headed sometimes, so I didn't think to double-check if the elevators had come online, and... whatever!
en: I'm kind of air-headed sometimes, so I didn't think to double-check if the elevators had come online, and...  whatever!
ja: わたし、時々ちょっとおっちょこちょいでさ、エレベーターが復旧してるかどうか確認するのを忘れてて……まあ、いいか!

key: Oh! My friend had something she wanted to give you.
en: Oh! My friend had something she wanted to give you.
ja: あ! 友達があなたに渡したいものがあるって言ってたよ。

key: I forget what it was, though.
en: I forget what it was, though.
ja: 何だったか忘れちゃったけど。

key: It looks like I'll be living here for a while, since the Jasper Ward is a total wreck.
en: It looks like I'll be living here for a while, since the Jasper Ward is a total wreck.
ja: ジャスパーワードがめちゃくちゃになっちゃったから、しばらくここに住むことになりそう。

key: But I don't mind! It's like a 24/7 never-ending sleep over! It'll be fun!
en: But I don't mind! It's like a 24/7 never-ending sleep over! It'll be fun!
ja: でも別にいいの! 24時間365日終わらないお泊まり会みたいなもんだし! 楽しそう!

key: ...Um, so did you notice that this house only has one bed?
en: ...Um, so did you notice that this house only has one bed?
ja: ……あの、この家にベッドが一つしかないの、気づいた?

key: This just got a little weird.
en: This just got a little weird.
ja: ちょっと変な感じになってきたな。

key: Oh well!
en: Oh well!
ja: まあいっか!

key: As long as she doesn't snore or anything, I'm sure it'll be fine!
en: As long as she doesn't snore or anything, I'm sure it'll be fine!
ja: いびきとかかかない限り、大丈夫だと思うし!

key: Oh, better get rid of this...
en: Oh, better get rid of this...
ja: あ、これは処分しとかなきゃ……

key: I suppose it wouldn't be so bad...
en: I suppose it wouldn't be so bad...
ja: まあ、そんなに悪くないかもね……

key: I'm really glad I got to live here! Staying with my, uh, friend, is so much fun!
en: I'm really glad I got to live here! Staying with my, uh, friend, is so much fun!
ja: ここに住めて本当によかった! その、友達と一緒にいるの、すごく楽しいんだ!

key: Who knew that not having separate beds would be a really, really nice thing?
en: Who knew that not having separate beds would be a really, really nice thing?
ja: ベッドが別々じゃないのが、こんなにいいことだなんて、誰が知ってた?
